title: Wendell and the Regiment
author: V. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Noor Thornbury, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
